body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> RIM presented its new smartphone 'Blackberry Bold 9700' during Digital Experience event at CES 2010.

Adopting a 2.44-inch HVGA display with 480x360 resolution, the Blackberry Bold 9700 features 256MB memory, Qwerty keyboard, a 3.2M auto focus camera with LED flash, 3.5mm headphone jack, external memory expandable up to 32GB, 3G & Wi-Fi connectivity and Bluetooth 2.1.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
